description: This file contains Go code implementing translation logic between in-tree AWS EBS volume representations and CSI (Container Storage Interface) volume representations, including functions for translating storage classes, inline volumes, PV objects, and volume handles, specifically for AWS EBS in Kubernetes.

classes.name: awsElasticBlockStoreCSITranslator
classes.description: A struct implementing translation methods between in-tree AWS EBS volume representations and CSI volume representations for Kubernetes.

methods.name: TranslateInTreeStorageClassToCSI
methods.description: Translates an in-tree Kubernetes StorageClass for AWS EBS to a CSI StorageClass, handling topology parameters and IOPS settings.

methods.name: TranslateInTreeInlineVolumeToCSI
methods.description: Converts an in-tree AWS EBS volume in a Volume object to a CSI PersistentVolume object.

methods.name: TranslateInTreePVToCSI
methods.description: Converts an in-tree PersistentVolume with AWS EBS source to a CSI PersistentVolume.

methods.name: TranslateCSIPVToInTree
methods.description: Converts a CSI PersistentVolume back to an in-tree AWS EBS PersistentVolume.

methods.name: CanSupport
methods.description: Checks if the plugin supports a given PersistentVolume.

methods.name: CanSupportInline
methods.description: Checks if the plugin supports a given inline volume.

methods.name: GetInTreePluginName
methods.description: Returns the name of the in-tree plugin driver for AWS EBS.

methods.name: GetCSIPluginName
methods.description: Returns the name of the CSI plugin for AWS EBS.

methods.name: RepairVolumeHandle
methods.description: Returns the volume handle, potentially for repair or normalization.

methods.name: KubernetesVolumeIDToEBSVolumeID
methods.description: Parses Kubernetes volume ID strings to extract the AWS EBS volume ID.

methods.name: getAwsRegionFromZones
methods.description: Derives AWS region from a list of zone strings.
